statement.zh: 发掘传统将库尔泰佩—卡内什表述为古亚述商站（kārum）泥板档案与安纳托利亚中心（Özgüç 传统）。
statement.en: Excavation tradition frames Kültepe-Kaneš as an Old Assyrian kārum tablet archive and Anatolian centre (Özgüç tradition).
